# Note Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something to record related to a note associated with an event.

## Scope note

Events related to note creation, modification, or lifecycle (e.g. an Obsidian note created/updated), distinct from ScriptEvent (automation-triggered).

## Broader

- [Diabetes Event](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
